up: Return exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1054504. Include the compound ChEMBL ID, the standard activity type, the standard relation, the standard value, the standard units, the assay ChEMBL ID, and the target ChEMBL ID. Filter to include only rows where the standard relation is '=' and the standard value is not null.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054504'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
